# Contributing

1. Fork it.
2. Clone your forked project: `git clone https://github.com/<your_name>/Set-Stereo-Default`
3. Create a feature branch off of the develop branch: `git checkout -b my-new-feature develop`
4. Run the tests and make sure they pass: `pip install -r requirements-dev.txt`, then `python -m pytest`
5. Commit your changes: `git commit -am 'Added some feature'`
6. Push to the branch: `git push origin my-new-feature`
7. Submit a pull request to develop branch.
